answer: Reaching the grove of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, clawed back after a replayed submission, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Work waits on the karst until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the oasis of the next round.
